title: Co-dfns Live Stream: Compiler Design and Architecture
summary: A two-hour live stream in which Aaron Hsu explains the architecture, design history and aesthetic of Co-dfns, his parallel APL compiler. He walks through the code and the reasoning behind its dense style.
why: HN readers say it changed their view of APL and array languages, with a clear walkthrough of how a compiler can be written in this style.

quote.text: Nothing has ever convinced me about the potential for array languages in practice quite like watching Aaron Hsu
